articles.text: TÁNG LÁN: Màikè Jiàoshòu, dǎrǎo nǐ le.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: Professor Michaels, I'm disturbing you.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Méi shénme, kuài qǐng zuò, wǒ zhèr luànqībāzāode, zài shōushi dōngxi.
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Not at all. Please sit down. It's a mess here, I'm packing.
TÁNG LÁN: Shénme shíhourde fēijī ya?
MS. TÁNG LÁN: When's your plane?
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Wǎnshangde, hái zǎo ne, bù jí bù jí, nǐ zuò ma.
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: In the evening. It's still early. No rush, no rush. Come on and sit down.
TÁNG LÁN: Wǒ lái sòng gěi nín yìběn yóulǎn huàcè.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: I've come to give you a photographic travel book.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Yóulǎn huàcè? Jiù shi wǒmen zài yóulǎn Wànlǐ Chángchéngde shíhou, wǒ xiǎng mǎide nèizhǒng?
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: A photographic travel book? Is it the kind I wanted to buy when we were touring the Great Wall of Ten Thousand Li?
TÁNG LÁN: Jiù shì. Zhèizhǒng huàcè xūyàoliàng kě dà le.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: Right. There sure is a great demand for this kind of book of photographs.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Shì ma! Ōuzhōu láide, Měizhōu láide, shénme dìfang láide rén dōu xiǎng mǎi yìběnr. Xūyàoliàng dāngrán yídìng hěn dà.
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Sure! Visitors from Europe, America, everywhere, all want to buy one. Of course there's a great demand.
TÁNG LÁN: Nèitian zài Bādálǐng, nín méiyou mǎizháo, jīntian wǒ gěi nín sònglai le.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: That day at Bādálǐng, you weren't able to find one, so today I'm bringing you one.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Zhēn xièxie ni, zhème diǎnr xiǎo shìr nǐ hái xiǎngzhe. Duōshǎo qián na?
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Thank you so much. Such a small thing and you still remembered it. How much was it?
TÁNG LÁN: Shi Lǚxíngshè sòng nínde. Wǒmen huānyíng nín zài lái.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: It's a gift from the Travel Service. We welcome you to come back again.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Nà, zhèizhī bǐ sòng gei ni.
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Then, take this pen as a gift.
TÁNG LÁN: Ō, bù kěyi, wǒmen bù kěyi jiēshòu kèrende lǐwù.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: Oh, I can't. We're not allowed to accept gifts from visitors.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Nàme sòng gei nǐmen Lǚxíngshè. Hái jìde nèitian wǒmen zài Shísānlíng ma?
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Then I give it to your Travel Service. Do you still remember that day at the Thirteen Tombs?
TÁNG LÁN: Duì, nèitian nín hěn gāoxìng.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: Yes. That day you were very happy.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Xīnshǎng Zhōngguó gǔdài jiànzhù yìshu shi wǒ zuì gāoxìngde shì. Nèitian wǒmen zhào xiàng le, nǐ hái jìde ma?
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: The thing that makes me happiest is admiring the ancient architectural art of China. That day we took pictures, do you remember?
TÁNG LÁN: Jìde. Nèitian nín gěi wǒmen Lǚxíngshède jǐge tóngzhì zhàole xiàng, nín hái zài zhàopiàn hòumian yòng Zhōngwén xiěle "Měi-Zhōng Yǒuhǎo" sìge zì.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: Yes. That day, you took a picture of us comrades from the Travel Service, and you wrote on the back of the picture "American-Chinese friendship."
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Duì, nàme jīntian nǐ sòng huàcè lai, wǒ sòng gei nǐmen yìzhī bǐ wèishénme bù kěyi ne?
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: Right. So then today since you've brought me the photographic travel book, what's wrong with my giving you a pen?
TÁNG LÁN: Hǎo. Wǒ dàibiǎo tóngzhìmen xièxie nín, huānyíng nín zài lái.
MS. TÁNG LÁN: All right. On behalf of the other comrades, I thank you and welcome you to come back again.
MÀIKÈ JIÀOSHÒU: Wǒ yídìng zài lái.
PROFESSOR MICHAELS: I'll be sure to.
